hints.title: Strict Increasing Requirement
hints.text: Each element at index i must be strictly greater than the element at index i - 1.

hints.title: Minimal Required Increment
hints.text: To minimize operations, set each element to exactly the predecessor value plus one if it is not already greater.

hints.title: Sequential Tracking
hints.text: Accumulate the difference between needed target value and actual value while updating current boundary.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass greedy left-to-right threshold tracking.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Non-greedy changes to earlier elements increase overall operation count.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply linear greedy incrementation to maintain strictly ascending sequence.
